name: GhostToastViewport
description: Notification region (role=region, data-ghost-live) that renders the visible stack and two visually hidden announcers: polite (role=status) for ordinary toasts and assertive (role=alert) for urgency: urgent. A toast is announced once when it becomes visible, never while it waits. The provider label names the region unless the consumer passes aria-labelledby or aria-label. Teleported to document.body by default. Creating, updating, promoting, or expiring a toast never moves focus.

props.name: as
props.description: Host element. Use `section` when the region should be a landmark.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport the region and both announcers to `document.body` after mount.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Replaces the whole stack. Render one `GhostToast` per item, keyed by `id`.

slots.name: toast
slots.description: Content of one toast, rendered per visible record (keyed by `id`).

parts.name: announcer-polite
parts.description: Visually hidden polite live region (role=status). Not a styling hook for visible UI.

parts.name: announcer-assertive
parts.description: Visually hidden assertive live region (role=alert). Not a styling hook for visible UI.
